title: A novel quinazoline derivative exhibits potent anticancer cytotoxicity via apoptosis and inhibition of angiogenesis in DMBA-induced mammary gland carcinoma.
authors: Rani, Soniya; Trivedi, Rimjhim; Ansari, Mohd Nazam; Saeedan, Abdulaziz S; Kumar, Dinesh; Singh, Sunil Kumar; Mukherjee, Alok; Singh, Manjari; Kaithwas, Gaurav
journal: Journal of biochemical and molecular toxicology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究喹唑啉衍生物通过激活FIH-1抑制HIF-1α抗乳腺癌，核心为小分子药物与蛋白互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: Mammary gland carcinoma is one of the most prevalent and deadly diseases among women globally. It is a type of solid malignant tumor. In this malignant tumor, the microenvironment becomes hypoxic in rapidly proliferating cancer cells. These cells undergo adaptive changes through the expression of hypoxia-inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) which is regulated by factor inhibiting HIF-1alpha (FIH-1). Considering this, we hypothesized that the chemical activation of FIH-1 would inhibit the hypoxic activity of HIF-1alpha in mammary gland carcinoma. A library of 67,609 chemical compounds was virtually screened against FIH-1 based on Lipinski's rule from the ZINC database. The BBAP-8 has been selected based on an excellent docking score (-8.352 Kcal/mol), favorable ADMET, and potential FIH-1 activator profile. Further, its in-vitro cytotoxicity and apoptotic activity were scrutinized against MCF-7 cells and in-vivo activity against 7,12-dimethylbenz[a]anthracene (DMBA) induced mammary gland carcinoma in Wistar rats. It exhibited significant cytotoxicity (IC50 = 16.59 +/- 0.49 muM) and activated apoptosis when scrutinized through DAPI, AO/EB, and JC-1 staining. Also, oral administration of BBAP-8 restored hemodynamic changes, normalized tissue architecture, and corrected metabolic abnormalities. The western blot analysis and mRNA expression analysis validated that BBAP-8 has the potential to activate FIH-1 with the downregulation of GLUT-1, VEGF, and Twist-1. Moreover, BBAP-8 fostered apoptosis, when evaluated through BCL-2, BAX, Caspase-8, and Caspase-3. Based on research findings, this implies that BBAP-8 activates FIH-1 and can be effective in chemotherapeutic treatment of mammary gland carcinoma.
abstract_zh: 乳腺腺癌是全球女性中最常见且致命的疾病之一。它是一种实体恶性肿瘤。在这种恶性肿瘤中，快速增殖的癌细胞微环境变得缺氧。这些细胞通过表达缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1alpha）发生适应性变化，该因子受HIF-1α抑制因子（FIH-1）调控。基于此，我们假设化学激活FIH-1将抑制乳腺腺癌中HIF-1alpha的缺氧活性。从ZINC数据库中，根据Lipinski规则，对67,609种化合物进行了针对FIH-1的虚拟筛选。基于优异的对接得分（-8.352 Kcal/mol）、良好的ADMET特性及潜在的FIH-1激活剂特征，选择了BBAP-8。进一步，我们检测了其对MCF-7细胞的体外细胞毒性和凋亡活性，以及对Wistar大鼠中7,12-二甲基苯并[a]蒽（DMBA）诱导的乳腺腺癌的体内活性。通过DAPI、AO/EB和JC-1染色检测，BBAP-8表现出显著的细胞毒性（IC50 = 16.59 ± 0.49 μM）并激活了凋亡。此外，口服BBAP-8恢复了血流动力学变化，正常化了组织架构，并纠正了代谢异常。Western blot分析和mRNA表达分析验证了BBAP-8具有激活FIH-1的潜力，并下调GLUT-1、VEGF和Twist-1的表达。此外，通过BCL-2、BAX、Caspase-8和Caspase-3的评估，BBAP-8促进了凋亡。基于研究结果，这表明BBAP-8激活FIH-1，并可能在乳腺腺癌的化疗治疗中有效。
